ross_ghillie.text: Welcome to Ross Castle. It is a tower house built by the O'Donoghue chiefs in the 1400s, on the shore of Lough Leane.
The legend says it would never fall until a warship sailed on the lake. In 1652 Parliament's forces brought boats, and the legend was right.
Red deer roam the park behind. In autumn the stags roar across the valley. Do not argue with a Stagmor.
